tier_should.rationale: Solid conceptual framing and novel text-based novelty metric backed by large-scale data; contributions suit top field outlets (e.g., Research Policy) but lack rigor/theory depth for top-five general journals.

tier_will.rationale: Likely placed in reputable field or interdisciplinary journal; essayistic style, broad claims, and NBER WP visibility help but methodological concerns and limited causal evidence impede acceptance at elite economics journals.
